request.name: Johnny Depp
request.title: Actor
request.about: John Christopher Depp II (born June 9, 1963) is an American actor and musician. He is the recipient of multiple accolades, including a Golden Globe Award as well as nominations for three Academy Awards and two British Academy Film Awards. His films, in which he has often played eccentric characters, have grossed over $8 billion worldwide, making him one of Hollywood's most bankable stars

events.event: Returned to film directing with the premiere of 'Modi: Three Days on the Wing of Madness', a biographical drama following Italian artist Amedeo Modigliani.
Opened his first major art exhibition titled 'A Bunch of Stuff' in New York City, showcasing artwork he created over three decades.
Made his return to the screen playing King Louis XV in the French-language period drama 'Jeanne du Barry', which premiered at the Cannes Film Festival.
Won a high-profile, highly publicized defamation lawsuit against his ex-wife Amber Heard in a Fairfax County, Virginia court, with a jury awarding him $15 million in damages.
Faced intense controversy and career turbulence after his third wife, Amber Heard, filed for divorce and obtained a temporary restraining order alleging domestic abuse, which Depp strongly denied.
Married his third wife, actress Amber Heard, in a private ceremony at their home in Los Angeles after meeting on the set of 'The Rum Diary'.
Announced his separation from long-term partner and French singer-actress Vanessa Paradis, with whom he spent 14 years together.
Welcomed the birth of his second child and son, John 'Jack' Christopher Depp III, with his partner Vanessa Paradis.
Welcomed the birth of his first child and daughter, Lily-Rose Melody Depp, with his partner Vanessa Paradis.
Finalized his divorce from his first wife, makeup artist Lori Anne Allison, whom he had married in 1983.
Born as John Christopher Depp II in Owensboro, Kentucky, to civil engineer John Christopher Depp and waitress Betty Sue Wells.
